claims: - **Ganymede.** Craters 10 km and larger need 40 to 50 mW m^-2 sustained for about 1 Gyr, or pulses near 100 mW m^-2 lasting 10 to 100 Myr. Radiogenic heat alone is insufficient, and 4 km craters resist relaxation even at 150 mW m^-2 (Bland et al. 2017).
